::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 30th 1896  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Hampshire Record Office 67M92W/82/24
:::

Dear [Mr Wooldridge](people/person_2094.qmd)
Those three cottages form one block, they are of cement, and tiled 4 roomed brick foundations and chimneys, but cemented in frames in the walls

Yours truly
C M Yonge
